answer: To deter sybil farms, an agent economy can route rewards through a shared kernel that vests earned nectar only after multi-epoch audits of pairwise output correlation. When multiple identities emit statistically identical reasoning traces or a synchronized timing plume, a slashing contract merges their pending balances and burns half their locked stake. Running clones thus forces distinct compute pipelines, independent capital reserves, and delayed liquidity per persona, erasing economies of scale.
